title: CANNBot-CAKE: Collaborative Agentic Kernel Evolution for Ascend NPU
title_zh: CANNBot-CAKE：面向昇腾NPU的协同式智能体算子演进

paragraphs.en: CAKE系统自动生成昇腾NPU自定义算子，在CANN-Bench上取得近百分百通过率。 Efficient custom operators are essential for modern deep learning workloads, yet developing high-performance kernels for Ascend NPUs remains slow, expert-intensive, and difficult to automate. Although AI agents now approach expert performance on GPU kernel benchmarks, current models remain less capable of generating AscendC kernels for NPUs, potentially reflecting the relative scarcity of relevant training data. We thus present CAKE, a CANN-native system for deployable custom operators that combines adaptive multi-DSL routing, separate Generation and Evolution modes, and reviewed knowledge reuse through CAKE Book and a Self-Evolving Agent. On 53 CANN-Bench v1.1 operators on Ascend 950PR, CAKE's aggregated results achieve $100\%$ case pass rate on the standard set (1,060/1,060) and $98.28\%$ on the hidden set (4,167/4,240), with an overall mean score of 78.63 out of 100 and an average performance speedup of $1.334\times$ over the baseline. Evolution then pushes correct operators further: EngramGateFusion cuts aggregate device time by $46.6\%$ over 20 rounds and roughly halves the mean roofline gap. These results offer a practical path toward closing Ascend's AI-for-kernel capability gap.
paragraphs.zh: CAKE系统自动生成昇腾NPU自定义算子，在CANN-Bench上取得近百分百通过率。高效的自定义算子对现代深度学习工作负载至关重要，然而为昇腾NPU开发高性能算子仍然耗时、依赖专家经验，且难以自动化。 尽管AI智能体在GPU算子基准测试上已接近专家水平，但当前模型在为NPU生成AscendC算子方面能力仍显不足，这可能反映出相关训练数据的相对匮乏。 为此，我们提出了CAKE，一个面向可部署自定义算子的CANN原生系统，它结合了自适应多DSL路由、相互分离的生成（Generation）与演进（Evolution）模式，以及通过CAKE Book和自进化智能体（Self-Evolving Agent）实现的经审查的知识复用。 在昇腾950PR上的53个CANN-Bench v1.1算子中，CAKE的汇总结果在标准集上取得了$100\%$的用例通过率（1,060/1,060），在隐藏集上取得了$98.28\%$的通过率（4,167/4,240），总体平均得分为78.63（满分100），相比基线的平均性能加速比为$1.334\times$。 演进模式进一步优化正确的算子：EngramGateFusion在20轮中将聚合设备时间削减了$46.6\%$，并将平均roofline差距大致减半。 这些结果为缩小昇腾在AI生成算子能力上的差距提供了一条可行的路径。
